correctness.rationale: On any cactus the random forest law factors over bridges and cycle blocks; pairwise connectivity is a product along the unique block-tree route. For a cycle, the exact numerator SZ-UV expands into ad times a nonnegative polynomial, bc times another nonnegative polynomial, and 2abcd. Two nontrivial bipartitions of all cycle edges have ad>0 or bc>0, proving strict local covariance. Strict bridge covariance and independent block multiplication give the global sign/equality criterion. The exact standalone script passes 1,095 rational symbolic/enumeration assertions; finite checks are corroboration only.
